verses.gurmukhi: ਤਰਿ ਡੁਬੈ ਡੁਬਾ ਤਰੈ ਪੀ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: tar ddubai ddubaa tarai pee piram piaalaa|

en.bdb: One who quaffs the cup of love superficially drowns himself but in fact getting inebriated one who drowns in it swims it and gets across.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਣਿ ਹਾਰੈ ਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਣੈ ਏਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: jin haarai haarai jinai eh gurmukh chaalaa|

en.bdb: This is the way of the gurmukhs that they lose while winning and losing everything they win one and all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਖੰਡੇ ਧਾਰ ਹੈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਭਰਨਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: maarag kha(n)dde dhaar hai bhavajal bharanaalaa|

en.bdb: The way into the world ocean is like a double edged sword is like a killing stone

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਲਹੁ ਨਿਕਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: vaalahu nikaa aakheeaai gur pa(n)th niraalaa|

en.bdb: The Guru's path is unique and it's teachings are subtler even than the hair itself.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਜਰੁ ਭਾਰ ਹੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: haumai bajar bhaar hai dhuramat dhuraalaa|

en.bdb: The disciple of the Guru loses his ego through the Gurmat

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਕੈ ਸਿਖੁ ਜਾਇ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit_en: gurmat aap gavai kai sikh jai sukhaalaa ||17||

en.bdb: , the wisdom of the Guru and goes across this world ocean.
